evidence: 100% of the hotel name appears on the page

verified_facts.text: Nekajui sits in Peninsula Papagayo, a 1,400-acre private peninsula on Costa Rica's Pacific coast.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our hotel is set in Costa Rica’s Papagayo Peninsula - a 1,400-acre private paradise on the Pacific coast.

verified_facts.text: Accommodations face views of Playa Pochote and the Pacific Ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: exclusive accommodations facing ethereal views of Playa Pochote and the Pacific Ocean

verified_facts.text: The name Nekajui comes from the Chorotega word for lush garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: Originating from the Chorotega word for “lush garden,” Nekajui Peninsula Papagayo, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve

verified_facts.text: Accommodations include glamping tents with private plunge pools and residences of two to five bedrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Glamping tents blend luxury with nature, featuring spacious, open-air designs and private plunge pools. Residences range from two to five bedrooms

verified_facts.text: Suite and tent stays include a complimentary minibar with a full honor bar, including alcoholic beverages.
verified_facts.excerpt: Suite & Tent stays include a complimentary minibar with a full honor bar, including alcoholic beverages.

verified_facts.text: Each stay has a dedicated Manzu who arranges personalized services and experiences.
verified_facts.excerpt: Your dedicated Manzu thoughtfully curates each stay through personalized arrangements, meaningful experiences, and effortless attention to detail

verified_facts.text: The daily resort fee covers Wi-Fi, priority reservations, wellness programming, beach club privileges and access to Papagayo Park.
verified_facts.excerpt: Included in the resort fee, enjoy seamless Wi Fi, priority reservations, wellness programming, beach club privileges, complimentary access to Papagayo Park

verified_facts.text: Puna serves Peruvian-influenced fine dining under Chef Diego Muñoz.
verified_facts.excerpt: Under Chef Diego Muñoz’s creative direction, Puna fuses Peru’s culinary heritage with Costa Rican freshness.

verified_facts.text: Niri Beach Club offers oceanfront dining with Iberian flavors and grill-forward dishes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy oceanfront dining with grill-forward dishes, natural wines, and vibrant cocktails in an immersive seaside setting in Costa Rica.

verified_facts.text: Café Rincón celebrates Costa Rica's coffee and cacao heritage with roasted-to-order brews and artisan chocolates.
verified_facts.excerpt: Café Rincón celebrates Costa Rica’s coffee and cacao heritage with roasted-to-order brews, artisan chocolates, and vibrant local flavors

verified_facts.text: Ámbar is a treetop restaurant serving botanical cocktails at sunset.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perched among treetops, Ámbar is a Papagayo restaurant offering the pinnacle of sunset indulgence. Sip bespoke botanical cocktails

verified_facts.text: Room service is available.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, room service is available at Nekajui Peninsula Papagayo, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve.

verified_facts.text: The spa has hydrotherapy pools, a movement studio and ocean-facing treatment villas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Featuring hydrotherapy pools, a movement studio and luxurious ocean-facing treatment villas

verified_facts.text: The Ocean Course at Peninsula Papagayo is an Arnold Palmer Signature Design course.
verified_facts.excerpt: Arnold Palmer Signature Design

verified_facts.text: The golf package includes daily breakfast for two at Mirador and one 18-hole round of golf for two per booking.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Golf Package includes daily Nekajui Reserve breakfast for two at Mirador and one 18-Hole round of golf for two per booking.

verified_facts.text: Papagayo Explorers runs guided hikes, ziplining and wildlife tours at The Outpost in the 250-acre Palmares Preserve.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore one of the world’s last remaining tropical dry forests at The Outpost, set within the 250-acre protected Palmares Preserve.

verified_facts.text: Camp Nekajui is a children's program for ages 4 to 12.
verified_facts.excerpt: Camp Nekajui invites children ages 4–12 into a vibrant world of creativity, nature, and imagination.

verified_facts.text: The fitness center is open 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
verified_facts.excerpt: Open 7 days a week, 24 hours a day

verified_facts.text: The property is at the end of the 253 National Route in Peninsula Papagayo, Guanacaste.
verified_facts.excerpt: End of the 253 National Route, Peninsula Papagayo,

verified_facts.text: Surf lessons are offered through SurfX.
verified_facts.excerpt: taking personalized surf lessons with expert coaches at SurfX

verified_facts.text: A funicular lets guests reach Niri Beach Club, though stairs beyond it make the beach less accessible.
verified_facts.excerpt: The funicular ensures any and everyone can reach Niri Beach Club, although the stairs thereafter make the beach less accessible.

verified_facts.text: There are three tents at the lowest elevation of the accommodations, just above the beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: There are three of them and they sit at the lowest elevation of all the accommodations—just a hop, skip, and tumble from the beach below.

verified_facts.text: The property has a fully staffed kids' club.
verified_facts.excerpt: On property, there’s also a fully-staffed kids’ club if you need some time apart for whatever reason.

subjective.text: The spa is by appointment only.
subjective.reason: promotional wording; rewrite as a plain fact or leave out
